data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'af-l-h', meaning to save or rescue. In Islamic tradition, Mufliha is a name for a girl who has been saved or rescued from a difficult situation, representing the power and grace of Allah. The name Mufliha carries the meaning “Saved, rescued” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mufliha usually hope their child will grow to embody saved, rescued and live with faith, good character and purpose.
